name: Qdrant
summary: Store and retrieve semantic memories, code snippets, and vector search results across Qdrant collections.
description: Qdrant's official MCP server built in Berlin and run locally via uvx (mcp-server-qdrant==0.8.1). Connects to Qdrant Cloud or a self-hosted Qdrant cluster using QDRANT_URL, QDRANT_API_KEY, and COLLECTION_NAME to store and retrieve semantic memories.
author: Qdrant
